acceptanceResults: render_human_outcome no longer takes a repository root path and performs no filesystem or crate-internal validation calls; it only formats an already-assembled input struct and a language code.

A new use-case function assembles the render input (OutcomeV2, the human-decision projection, and the archived-unclosed fact) by calling outcome_v2_with_runtime plus the existing close_decision_is_valid_for_status/load_human_decision logic exactly once each; that logic is not duplicated.

The four existing call sites (crates/cockpit-cli/src/main.rs WorkItemCommand::Outcome, print_lifecycle_result, emit_blocked_lifecycle_handoff; crates/cockpit-mcp/src/lib.rs work_item_outcome) are migrated to the new assemble-then-render flow.
render_human_outcome is directly unit-testable by constructing its input struct in memory, with no repository directory or filesystem required.

Behavioral parity is proven for: missing human decision, invalid/malformed human decision, valid approved human decision, an archived-but-unclosed Work Item, and a historical/superseded Work Item -- same rendered text before and after this refactor for each case.
cargo fmt, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, and cargo test --locked --workspace pass; CLI/MCP JSON output, exit codes, and governance semantics are unchanged.
